translations.web: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
translations.bsb: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
translations.kjv: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
translations.asv: Trust in Jehovah, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on his faithfulness.
